parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence and no documented facility, border or custody restriction; constitutional and statutory anti-discrimination protections with criminal penalties exist, and the 2016 gender-identity law is resident-facing, so it is climate only. Negatives: the 2017 ombudsman reported that most LGBT murders were uninvestigated and none produced a sentence, which is impunity evidence but not trans-specific; the 2024 survey covers LGBTI people broadly, so it carries little current trans-specific weight; societal discrimination is described as common with no trans-visitor incident record. Open questions remain on detention placement, hospital wards and border treatment of foreign markers. The dossier is moderately documented, so silence on visitor-facing rules is weakly positive. Structural signals point toward a reduced-risk band held down by weak enforcement and unverified visitor-facing practice.
